description: Jobs — List the user's applications, newest first: ones Worklittle is filling out now (status active, with session_id to check or stop), pending ones (matched by auto-apply or waiting for approval) and finished ones (completed = submitted, failed, stopped). Use days for a period (7 = the last week). Check it before applying so the same job is never applied to twice. Filter with status, days, job_id or applicant_id.

applicant_id.description: "me" for the user's own, or an applicant id (required on a shared API key)

days.description: Only applications started or updated in the last this many days (7 = last week, 30 = last month).

name: list_applications

outputSchema.description: Read result from the Worklittle API.

title: Jobs · List Applications
